title: fetch.py drops <aside> sidebars that hold page content, so facts from them are never anchored
goal: The HTML-to-text reduction in _tools/fetch.py keeps the text of a content sidebar (an <aside> inside the article body, such as the sre.google book's data-type=sidebar boxes) while still skipping navigation asides, so provider.py read and factdiff.py anchor find a quote that sits in such a sidebar.

run:
import sys sys.path.insert(0, '_tools') import fetch # a content sidebar inside the article body is kept; an aside in
or with role=navigation is still skipped body = ('

Menu link list

' '

On this page

Effective troubleshooting

' + '

Body text of the chapter, long enough to read as a page.

' * 12 + '
Wild goose chases

A sidebar that holds page content.

' '
').encode() t = fetch.to_text(body, 'text/html') kept, nav = 'Wild goose chases' in t, ('Menu link list' in t or 'On this page' in t) print('content sidebar kept:', kept, '| navigation aside shown:', nav) sys.exit(0 if kept and not nav else 1)
